name: Torredelcampo (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and purple, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Torredelcampo (a castle on red above green).
history: Municipal flag of Torredelcampo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Torredelcampo arms — castle on red above green
castle and crown of the arms
